fee_notes: Traditional Restaurant: $30,000 (first unit), reduced to $15,000 for second and subsequent traditional restaurants. Non-Traditional Restaurant: $20,000 (first unit), reduced to $10,000 for second and subsequent non-traditional restaurants. Eligible Military (active, active reserve, or honorably discharged) and federally recognized 501(c)(3) organizations receive a 20% discount on the Initial Franchise Fee. No refunds under any circumstances. Fee is waived for transfer or renewal signings. Franchisor may periodically reduce the fee for limited-time promotions.
raw_excerpt: The initial franchise fee (" Initial Franchise Fee") for your Baja Fresh Traditional Restaurant is $30,000. The Initial Franchise Fee is reduced for your second and each subsequent traditional restaurant to $15,000. The Initial Franchise Fee for your Baja Fresh Non-Traditional Restaurant location is $20,000. The Initial Franchise Fee is reduced for your second and each subsequent non-traditional restaurant to $10,000.
